column_description: VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY uniquely identifying each environment record.
UUID REFERENCES Plant(GrowRegistry), referencing which plant area is monitored.
TIMESTAMP noting when these environmental readings were taken (e.g., '2023-07-15 10:30:00').
DECIMAL(7,3) measuring the cell temperature in °C (was 'CellTemperatureC') (e.g., 55.120).
SMALLINT indicating the scheduled cleaning cycle in days (was 'CleaningCycleDays') (e.g., 30).
DATE for when the last cleaning happened (was 'LastCleaningDate') (e.g., '2023-06-01').
